verdict.rationale: Sprinto's own docs say teams work 'with your team and auditor in-platform'. They also describe an audit-partner selection flow and AI validation of evidence 'before audit submission', which points to auditors reviewing evidence inside the platform rather than over email. However, every item is a one-line marketing summary or a page title, and none describes a dedicated, permission-scoped auditor view of controls and evidence. Missing for 10: a documented auditor role or scoped auditor portal, an explanation of what auditors can see and do with controls and evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the auditor workflow.
